# hyperfluid_sql_engine_cluster (Data Source)

Look up an existing SQL engine cluster by name within an environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_env" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

data "hyperfluid_sql_engine_cluster" "analytics" {
  env  = data.hyperfluid_env.default.id
  name = "analytics"
}

output "sql_engine_host" {
  value = data.hyperfluid_sql_engine_cluster.analytics.host
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `env` (String) Environment id the cluster runs in.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `host` (String) External host, empty when not exposed.
- `id` (String) Cluster id.
- `port` (Number) External port.
- `status` (String) Current status, such as `Online` or `Sleeping`.
- `worker_replicas` (Number) Number of Trino workers.
